note: `kernel_path` is the PER-PRIMITIVE binding read off the loaded model, not the package inventory.  transformers binds the four Gated-DeltaNet primitives independently, so fla's Triton chunked kernel runs even when causal_conv1d is absent and the 'fast path is not available' warning fires -- that warning is printed off is_fast_path_available, which is all() of the four.  `inventory_label_v1_refuted` is what the earlier, wrong rule would have printed, published only so v1 dossiers can be lined up against v2 ones.  Recorded, never enforced.
